title: sos_mcast_membership: end-to-end ff02::1 CoAP POST delivery test (R-12-036 full proof)
description: Follow-up from l1qw.37.2 (worker7). The new lichen/tests/sos_mcast_membership ztest proves the group-membership prerequisite (ff02::1 joined under CONFIG_NET_IPV6_MLD=y, not joined under =n, both verified at .config/autoconf/runtime level on native_sim/native/64). Remaining for full R-12-036 proof: on native_sim with the LICHEN L2 (CONFIG_LORA_LOOPBACK=y), a CoAP client in the same app POSTs coap://[ff02::1]/sos and sos_post (coap_server.c:448) actually runs and returns success, proving socket-level multicast delivery. Build via plain west build (twister currently drops prj.conf on this box - see twin bead on the twister anomaly); puck native_sim needs -DLICHEN_TIME_BUILD_EPOCH_MODE=developer-generated -DLICHEN_DEVELOPER_BUILD_EPOCH_UNIX=<n>. Parent: l1qw.37.
